title: Validate invoice line items
summary: An invoice import should report all invalid line items in one pass instead of failing at the first problem. Validate each record and collect field-level issues in the specified structure. Validate invoice records and collect all field-level problems.
requirements: Description must be a nonempty string after trimming.
Quantity must be a positive safe integer, and unitCents a nonnegative safe integer.
Return {valid,errors}; messages are line i: description, quantity, price in that order.
hints: Validate every field for every line, without stopping at the first error.
Build error strings with the zero-based line index and field name.
